name: A story - A experiment: LOVE
source:
Did you ever wanted to step inside a kaleidoscope?! While a Demon tells you a little story about the ruling deity of their world????!! NOW IT'S YOUR CHANCE!!

Explore a little story about love and another 4 letter word.

[From [url=https://taumilicorice.itch.io/a-story-a-experiment-love]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
你想不想走進萬花筒裡？！再讓一個惡魔給你講講統治它們世界的神明的故事？！現在機會來了！

來看看這個小故事，它關乎愛（love），也關乎另一個同樣由四個字母拼成的詞。

［摘自[url=https://taumilicorice.itch.io/a-story-a-experiment-love]itch.io[/url]］
